provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: Extend the default branch-likely rule (P28) with a fallback for branches whose condition register was produced by an arithmetic comparison (e.g. slt): get_condition then reports the producer comparison instead of the branch's zero test, so use the branch's own comparison. If the branch is `ne dest,0` with a zero delay-slot write, the skipped write is a no-op on the not-taken path (semantically safe).
mechanism: gcc/config/mips/mips.c mips_r5900_annul_dead_slots(): when the P28 zero-test checks fail, read the branch's own if_then_else comparison; accept it when it is NE against zero (or $0) and the delay-slot source is zero, setting safe = 1.

evidence.note: P28's own path is unchanged for its units (the fallback only runs when the P28 checks reject)
